ℹ About Integrations
Full live sync requires backend OAuth. All data stays in your browser. For automated sync, self-host with Node.js and configure API credentials.

• Trading 212 — unofficial CSV export / unofficial REST API
• Interactive Brokers — IBKR TWS Gateway API
• Coinbase / Binance — Official REST APIs (API key + secret)
• BullionVault — XML data API
• TrueLayer — UK Open Banking (OAuth2)
